sources.title: OpenAI Codex GitHub releases
sources.takeaway: The release surface showed Codex CLI 0.137.0 as the latest stable label while 0.138.0 alpha prereleases were also visible. Treat local installed-version receipts as installed-state evidence and release pages as capability and source-drift guidance.

sources.title: OpenAI Codex GitHub repository
sources.takeaway: Codex remains a terminal coding agent with release-asset installation paths; THOS should keep local version checks, help probes, and app-server readiness receipts rather than relying on one surface.

sources.title: MCP security best practices
sources.takeaway: MCP work should preserve per-client consent, redirect validation, state validation, local-server consent, scope minimization, and protection against confused-deputy, SSRF, session, and local-server risks.

sources.title: MCP authorization specification
sources.takeaway: Authorization and capability boundaries should remain explicit; THOS connector runners should default to read-only unless an exact approval packet grants mutation.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
sources.takeaway: Prompt-injection, sensitive-output, excessive-agency, supply-chain, and unbounded-consumption risks justify the existing no-raw-output, exact-approval, and guard-scan publication model.

sources.title: NVIDIA AI factories
sources.takeaway: AI-factory architecture emphasizes validated designs, agentic workloads, networking, orchestration, data pipelines, and digital-twin style simulation; THOS can borrow the validated-design pattern without claiming hardware deployment.

sources.title: NVIDIA enterprise reference architectures
sources.takeaway: Reference architectures stress full-stack compatibility, high-bandwidth networking, and repeatable deployment patterns; THOS helper and watcher maps should follow the same compatibility-led design discipline.

carry_forward_rules: Prefer primary sources over raw search volume.
Keep web research read-only unless a later exact packet grants mutation.
Use source-drift cautions whenever public release pages and local installed-state receipts differ.
Map security sources into practical THOS guardrails rather than abstract claims.
Keep all GMUT/THOS empirical, physics, consciousness, and canon gates open.
